t: The Blazing Generator burns Blazing Rods for FE. Normal blaze rods must first be processed in the $(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/blazingagitator)Blazing Agitator$(/l).
烈焰发电机通过燃烧充能烈焰棒来产生FE。普通烈焰棒必须先经$(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/blazingagitator)烈焰激活器$(/l)处理。
A Blazing Rod has two important values: power output and duration. Higher quality rods produce more FE/t, and longer duration rods keep the generator running longer.
充能烈焰棒有两个关键数值：功率输出与持续时间。高品质烈焰棒单位时间产电更多（FE/t），长时效烈焰棒则能使发电机运行更久。
The generator can use up to four rods and works best when it runs continuously. It needs time to warm up before it reaches the full potential of the inserted rods.
该发电机最多可同时使用四根烈焰棒，连续运行时效率最佳。插入烈焰棒后需一定预热时间，才能充分发挥其全部潜力。
